title: When the Songbook Breaks Again
author: H. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Ansel Sterling, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
